steps: Download the GitHub Actions artifact and extract its outer ZIP into a fresh folder.
Keep the inner evaluator ZIP, matching .zip.sha256, owner PowerShell launcher and seal together.
Run the supplied PowerShell launcher against the inner ZIP. It verifies archive/payload integrity, extracts to a fresh folder and launches ordinary Workbench.
For later launches, use Open Workbench.cmd in the installed evaluator folder.
